practice_questions.question_text: Explain how supervised and unsupervised learning would differ when analysing player behaviour records.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
practice_questions.solution: Supervised learning uses examples with target labels/outcomes.; It can learn to predict those labels for new records.; Unsupervised learning uses data without target class labels.; It can discover groups/patterns of similar behaviour.; Thus predicted outcome categories and discovered groups answer different questions; unsupervised does not mean random or deeper learning.

marking_points.criterion: Supervised learning uses examples with target labels/outcomes.
It can learn to predict those labels for new records.
Unsupervised learning uses data without target class labels.
It can discover groups/patterns of similar behaviour.
Thus predicted outcome categories and discovered groups answer different questions; unsupervised does not mean random or deeper learning.

practice_questions.question_text: Explain how transfer learning and data cleaning can help develop a useful ML text classifier from a small task-specific dataset.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Retains supported transfer/data quality subsets; does not introduce transformer attention, NLPembeddings or historical research requirements.
practice_questions.solution: Transfer learning reuses a model trained on a related larger task/dataset.; Its learned representations provide a starting point rather than learning everything from scratch.; Adapting it to the target task can reduce the amount of task-specific training required.; Cleaning removes incorrect, duplicate or mislabelled examples that distort learning.; The adapted model still needs evaluation on relevant data; transfer does not guarantee accuracy if the source and target differ substantially.

marking_points.criterion: Transfer learning reuses a model trained on a related larger task/dataset.
Its learned representations provide a starting point rather than learning everything from scratch.
Adapting it to the target task can reduce the amount of task-specific training required.
Cleaning removes incorrect, duplicate or mislabelled examples that distort learning.
The adapted model still needs evaluation on relevant data; transfer does not guarantee accuracy if the source and target differ substantially.
